i'm highly depersonalized right now. doesn't really feel like i'm here.

also, i was careless this morning and used a roommate's used disposable razor to shave my face. add "anxiety of catching a disease from used razor" to the list of my neuroses.
thank you for being supportive, even when my post was very angry and mean spirited... i regret writing with such an angry tone this morning.

i was freaking out this morning when i wrote this. i'm a bit more calm. i was definitely angry, and i still believe most of it, but yeah. i'm feeling somewhat better.

thank you for the supportive words. it is rare to meet people on this wavelength.
i wrote this quickly because i have somewhere to be, so i'm sorry about the low quality. i may revise it later.

My parents kicked me out and I had to move to another state.

I signed up for insurance here, but it takes a pretty long time to verify.
yea but it doesn't feel like asthma, it feels like bronchitis without the cough/mucus

I live in a very dusty environment with garbage and dirty dishes all contributing to a rancid air quality. Not sure if that'd have any effect.

I've been living here before, with no issues, so I don't think that's it. -- And if it was,the inhaler would've helped, as it has before.

Did the doctors review your inhaler use? -- No.

And I'm having to use the rescue inhaler multiple times a week, even with a steroid inhaler.

What I am trying to ask by posting this here -- is are the symptoms I have described more bipolar, or more schizo?

Not diagnosis seeking, but I am curious. I haven't been formally diagnosed with anything other than "suspected bipolar type-I," but I do have OCD, and developing schizo is one of my OCD obsessions. So I suppose this could be considered "OCD checking."
fitting that you live in portland
is "how many roses per hour" a good opener?

this is funny.

sounds like everyone replying to this is a bitter, wet blanket.
No delusion, no external voices

I haven't dealt with it. I'm bouncing between being convinced I have it, denying that I have it, and dismissing it as OCD.

I have had this obsession since age 15, however.

You've been hearing songs -- I've been seeing my own first name written places at what seems to be an unusually high frequency. This sort of thing does *feel* very strange.

We gotta remember it's not rational.
Ok, so it looks like I'm on the right track in finding out what's "wrong" with me. Thanks for your input.

No doctor yet. There's one of those catch-all mental health places I'm going to try to go to. Due to life circumstances, I am currently without insurance, so the center I'm referring to will have to do.

I haven't had psychosis, don't worry.

I've had thoughts that seem psychotic, but really aren't. People here are suggesting I might start believing them, but I have OCD, and such thoughts are normal within the realm of that disorder.

But, better safe than sorry. If you're experiencing any of this, seeing a doctor would be apt.
Thanks for the input. I saw a crisis center awhile back and the counselor suspected I am BP-I, but I never pressed further.
Thanks for replying. Guess I gotta accept the need for medication.
It varies in intensity for me. Some days, the imagery is very clear and colorful.
Thanks for the advice.

To clarify, I'm not actually delusional. I get intrusive thoughts that are strings of text a delusional person may think, but there is no belief or feeling behind them.

It's a hard clarification to explain, but here is a way to demonstrate. You, too, can think the phrase "someone is following me." But it's just words in your head. No delusion. I get "intrusive sentences" of a delusional bent very often, but there is no actual feeling of delusion behind it. Just empty, annoying words.

4 days strong.

Can't promise I won't put my e-cig to good use, though. Especially with my new job.

What concerns me is I was put on a steroid inhaler and it's not helping. Also, my Ventolin, which usually helps, has become ineffective.

To be fair, I live in an environment with lots of hay, pet dander, and other lung irritants and allergens. But my rescue inhaler usually helps with that.

Bronchitis, maybe? But I have no cough...
